necessarios.descricao: They make the site work and store choices the visitor asked for (language, the consent record). They are exempt from consent and cannot be turned off.

estatisticas.descricao: They count visits in aggregate so we can see which pages are useful. Without them we do not know what to improve, but the site works just the same.

marketing.descricao: They allow campaigns to be measured and third-party content to be shown (maps, videos, social networks). The site uses none today; the category is ready for when it does.

quemSomos.title: Building the future with quality and sustainability

meta.label: architecture, engineering, interior design, construction and property management

quemSomos.paragrafo: We build to last: sustainable solutions, materials we trust, and rigorous quality control at every stage of construction, so the final result is as solid as the 20 years of history behind it.

oQueFazemos.title: Quality — Comfort — Sustainability — Innovation
oQueFazemos.lead: From the initial site study to handing over the keys, AM Santos designs, builds and oversees every development with the same rigour — so that quality, comfort, sustainability and innovation stop being promises and become verifiable standards in every square metre.

pilares.title: Quality
pilares.texto: Every project is overseen from design through to completion, with rigorous control over materials and finishes at every stage.

pilares.title: Comfort
pilares.texto: Spaces designed for the everyday lives of those who live in them, with functional architecture that prioritises light, flow and wellbeing.

pilares.title: Sustainability
pilares.texto: Energy-efficient solutions and durable materials that reduce environmental impact and long-term maintenance costs.

pilares.title: Innovation
pilares.texto: We explore new market segments and construction solutions, anticipating market trends to shape the next step of every development.

oQueFazemos.statsLead: Two decades of experience translated into results: every project completed, every square metre built and every million invested reflects AM Santos's same commitment to quality and sustainability.

members.bio: Leads AM Santos and the architecture, engineering, interior design and property management team that shapes every project, with 20 years of experience in the real estate market.
Head of the design department, translating into drawings the modern, functional architecture that defines every development, from concept to construction.
Site director, coordinating the execution and quality control that underpin the excellence of every completed project.
Works on interiors and finishes, so that every home reflects the comfort and quality that define the company.
Responsible for property management and overseeing pipeline projects, from initial study through to sale.

quemSomos.title: Building the future with quality and sustainability
quemSomos.lead: With 20 years of experience in the real estate market, AM Santos stands out for its excellence in every project it undertakes.
quemSomos.paragrafo: Under the leadership of António M Santos, the company brings together a team of top-level architecture, engineering, interior design and property management professionals. Since our founding, our vision has been to provide comfort and quality to our clients through projects that combine modern, functional architecture with an unwavering focus on wellbeing and quality.

items.title: At the forefront of architectural innovation
items.texto: With several projects in the pipeline, we stay at the forefront of architectural innovation, prioritising quality, comfort and energy efficiency to ensure our clients' satisfaction.

items.title: An eco-friendly approach
items.texto: Our latest project was designed with sustainable materials to combine comfort, wellbeing and modern architecture — reducing maintenance costs and ensuring maximum thermal comfort.

items.title: Social responsibility
items.texto: More than building, we want to contribute. In every project, we look for ways to generate social impact, supporting initiatives that respond to the needs of the surrounding community and leave a positive mark on every place we work in.

footer.blurb: Building the future with quality and sustainability. Modern, functional architecture with an unwavering focus on the wellbeing of those who live there.

edificio-bairro-da-vitoria.resumo: 10 apartments of T2 and T3 typology, in Loures. The group's first development and the start of a 20-year journey in the real estate market.

condominio-casas-da-murteira.resumo: Residential condominium of 10 villas, Casas da Murteira, with privileged spaces integrated into the landscape, located on a hillside.

condominio-das-almoinhas.resumo: Aimed at the mid-to-upper segment of the housing market, the 7 villas are characterised by contemporary lines that prioritise interior space and natural light, achieved through large skylights, expansive glazed openings, a mezzanine and the fluidity of open-plan space.

condominio-casas-da-fonte-velha.resumo: Residential condominium of 16 villas, with open spaces and interior courtyards. Every space was carefully designed in its finishes and textures, creating a refined and comfortable atmosphere.

condominio-santos-murteira-ii.resumo: Santos Condominium, also in Murteira, comprising 11 detached single-storey villas of T4 and T5 typology, each with a private pool, making the courtyard the generating element of the residential space and fostering privacy, quality of life and a relationship with natural light.

condominio-santos-malhapao.resumo: Private condominium of 8 villas of T4 and T5 typology, each with a private pool, making the courtyard the generating element of the residential space and fostering privacy, quality of life and a relationship with natural light.

condominio-santos-moradia-isolada-t5.resumo: A 5-bedroom villa with a private pool that makes the courtyard the generator of the residential space, fostering privacy, quality of life and a relationship with natural light.

condominio-tojalinho.resumo: Gated condominium of 3 villas of T4 typology, in Tojalinho, Loures.

condominio-albarraque.resumo: Currently in the planning stage, in partnership with relevant authorities (the Municipal Council and others), the Santos Condominium — Sintra will feature 9 T4 villas each with a private pool, fostering privacy, quality of life and a relationship with natural light.

empreendimento-residencial-11-villas.resumo: Currently under construction, the Santos Condominium will feature 11 villas of T4 and T5 typology, each with a private pool, making the courtyard the generating element of the residential space.

moradia-unifamiliar-santo-antao-do-tojal.resumo: Currently under construction, a 4-bedroom villa with a private pool, making the courtyard a key element of the residential space and fostering privacy, quality of life and a relationship with natural light.

valflores-terraces.resumo: A building with 39 apartments — T3, T3 duplex, T4, T4 duplex and T5 premium — with generous indoor and outdoor areas and outstanding views over the landscape. The apartments on the upper floors have a landscaped outdoor pool. Unobstructed views and spacious balconies overlooking the Tagus River. Elegant, refined interior finishes, and comfortable, contemporary spaces filled with natural light.
factos: T3 / T3 duplex / T4 / T4 duplex / T5 premium

clt-centro-logistico-do-tojal.resumo: New warehouses of modern architecture, set within a gated business complex, totalling 36.000 m² of industrial space, in Santo Antão do Tojal, Loures. Each warehouse offers 1.000 m² with a 10 m ceiling height, sanitary facilities, a 100 m² open-plan office (mezzanine) with bathroom, truck loading and unloading docks, and outdoor parking.

valflores-residence.resumo: As in every AM Santos development, Valflores Residence is born from a vision centred on the new market segment that AM Santos is developing.

pinteus-residence.resumo: As in every AM Santos development, Pinteus Residence is born from a vision centred on the new market segment that AM Santos is developing.

empreendimento-loures-residencial.tipologia: T1, T2, T3, T5 and T6
empreendimento-loures-residencial.resumo: A high-end, innovative gated condominium with 155 apartments of T1, T2, T3, T5 and T6 typology, for housing.
factos: T1, T2, T3, T5 and T6

empreendimento-loures-hotel.resumo: A hotel with around 50 rooms, conference rooms, a restaurant and other amenities, featuring modern architecture.

quinta-das-amoreiras.resumo: Made up of several gated condominiums combining nature, river views and innovation, in a new lifestyle in the city of Lisbon. With a total of 600 apartments, a hotel and commercial spaces.
